verdict.rationale: Hightouch's official MCP server lets an AI assistant build audiences from plain-language prompts, such as creating a cart-abandoner audience. Its capabilities include understanding the customer schema, which grounds the build in the user's actual data, and a built-in agent explores segments in natural language. The docs do not show the generated segment definition being presented for review before it is saved; the only review statement is a general one about agents' work. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a review/approval step for the AI-generated segment definition, detail on how schema grounding shapes the generated definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema

citations.quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.
Marketers guide, review, and refine the agents’ work before anything launches.
